svg.title: Mockup 05: alert settings for the event
svg.text: 05 · Alert settings: where the event's alerts go and what they are about (organiser)
A tab of Health, saved like every settings form (the save bar). The channel comes from the bot's binding; the webhook is a write-only secret like step 5's AI key.
Use case: before the event, an organiser picks the alert channel and role, sets the fallback webhook and tunes which problems alert, and how soon
A · Alert settings at 1280 px (a form page: 40 rem)
Down alerts mention the role; everything else only posts.
From the bot's binding · Change in Discord ›
A role the crew already manages (U3)
Set by Player Three, 12 Nov · last used today 16:03
Only when the bot is down or is the subject.
Each problem, when it alerts, and the fix tried first. Off still shows on Health.
Screens refused by the venue check
The platform's parts alert the superadmins, not you; you see one word for them.
Quiet during the run of show's quiet hours
Screens may be dark at night (E9).
B · The same on a phone

g.text: Paste the webhook URL Discord gives for the alert
channel. It is stored encrypted and never shown
Saved. A test reached the channel.
Replace swaps it at once; the old one
stops being used. Audited, never the URL.
The old webhook stays in use. Check the URL
or make a new one in the channel's settings.
